scripts.docker:prune: docker compose down -v --rmi all --remove-orphans && docker volume prune -f
scripts.db:generate: cd services/games && bun run db:generate && cd ../wallets && bun run db:generate
scripts.check:types: bun run db:generate && bunx tsc --noEmit -p services/games/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p services/wallets/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.quality.json
scripts.test:unit: cd services/games && bun test tests/unit && cd ../wallets && bun test tests/unit && cd ../../frontend && bun run test && cd .. && bun test scripts/quality
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf coverage && cd services/games && bun test tests/unit --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=../../coverage/services-games && cd ../wallets && bun test tests/unit --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=../../coverage/services-wallets && cd ../../frontend && bunx vitest run --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reportsDirectory=../coverage/frontend && cd .. && bun test scripts/quality --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=coverage/scripts-quality
scripts.ci:local: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run lint && bun run check:types && bun run test:unit && bun run test:coverage && bun run quality:gate && docker compose config
scripts.ci:e2e: docker compose up -d --build && bun scripts/ci/check-kong-health.ts && cd services/games && bun test tests/e2e
